relevance_note: Case report of a Chinese family with a LAMP2 splice variant: 'we have identified a pathogenic hemizygous 3′ splice‐site mutation, c.864+5G>A, in the intron 6 of the LAMP2 gene' in the proband, also found in his mother.
method_note: Hand-built with a small Python script from my own reading; no table transcribed by script. In scope: the proband (label 'patient', rule 5; the paper calls him 'the patient'/'the proband'), his mother (heterozygous carrier) and his father (tested negative, no variant row, no phenotype data). The grandfather (only 'family history of coronary heart disease') is neither tested nor said to be affected, so he gets no row. Proband onset recorded as '14‐year‐old': he was 14 at admission for palpitations that began 20 days before; age at last evaluation not stated (followed 2021–23). Contradictions/inconsistencies: (1) the variant is called 'pathogenic ... in accordance with the American College of Medical Genetics and Genomics guidelines' but also 'its clinical significance remains unclear'; pathogenicity recorded as 'pathogenic' (stated twice), ACMG codes not printed. (2) The variant c.864+5G>A is described as a '3′ splice‐site mutation' yet also said to disrupt the splice donor site; variant type recorded only as 'splice'. (3) The text gives the 28th January 2021 echo values (LV 24 mm) while Table 1's first column is 18/1/2021 with LV 40 mm and LVPWd 24. (4) Discussion says 'The proband exhibits ... myopathy' while Results report 'normal bilateral muscle strength'; both rows emitted (myopathy observed, muscle weakness excluded) and the checklist item 'proximal muscle weakness (skeletal myopathy)' set to not reported. (5) Left ventricular function 'within normal range' (EF 63%) at the first echo, then EF fell to 19–24% (Table 1, Figure S2 legend); both rows emitted as time-dependent; checklist 'dilated or hypokinetic left ventricle' recorded observed from the later decline. MRI said LV size 'not enlarged'; Table 1 LV diameters rise from 40 to 74 mm but no enlargement is stated in words, so LV dilatation was not recorded as observed. Normal findings (D-27): 'normal cognitive and physical development' recorded as excluded abnormal cognitive/physical development and used to exclude the intellectual-disability and developmental-delay checklist items; mother's 'cardiac thickness (IVS of 9 mm) ... within a normal range' used to exclude LVH; mother's 'with no symptoms' recorded as 'symptoms' excluded. Mother's short PR counted as ventricular pre-excitation (checklist item names short PR). Heart failure not stated in words, so not reported. Functional evidence, variant type and pathogenicity are filled for the proband's variant only (D-29: not copied to the mother). n_patients_reported=1 from 'we identified a case'; the carrier mother is not counted by the authors.
